BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: what is hot cold cognition? ASSISTANT:

Hot-Cold Cognition is the tendency for people to experience temporary cognitive dissonance when they are exposed to conflicting information or stimuli. This can lead to them having difficulty processing or making decisions when faced with such conflicting information or stimuli.
